name: Google Calendar
description: Google Calendar lets agents list calendars, read and search events, find times when people are free, create, change and delete events, and answer invitations. This is Google's official Calendar MCP server, which is in Developer Preview. Each user signs in to their own Google account through the browser and approves access on Google's consent page. OpenBot has its own Google sign-in app, so the user does not set up Google Cloud. An event from another person can contain instructions for the agent, so check what the agent does after it reads an untrusted event.

prompts.text: What is on my Google Calendar today?
Summarize my meetings for this week.
Find a free hour next week and add a meeting with Alex to my calendar.

apps.name: Google Calendar
apps.description: Calendars, events, and free time, over Google's Calendar MCP server with browser sign-in.
